sentences.text: Never cross the freezing river after midnight in Russia, the old tales say.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: My cousin and I walked down to the muddy bank where a silent ferry waited to take us across.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The old village ferryman smiled warmly at us, but on the ground his shadow stretched with huge branching horns.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: We should have turned back right then.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Something older than the village stirred beneath the black water, pushing the boat toward the far shore.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: We scrambled up the dark pathway and ran toward the safety of the nearest wooden house.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The heavy wooden door slammed shut, but long sharp claws began to scratch loudly against the planks outside.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: A sudden silence fell over the room, leaving only a dark smear left upon the frost outside.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Do you still hear that slow scratching at your door tonight?
sentences.speaker: narrator
